beats.name: Problem: Unindexed Query
beats.teaching_message: Finding a row by ID in an unindexed table requires checking every row.
beats.primary_visual_focus: Database table with 16 rows, target row (ID=77) subtly marked
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: Establishes the database as a linear, unordered structure where location doesn't imply order—mirroring real table heaps.

beats.name: Inefficient Full Table Scan
beats.teaching_message: Without an index, the database performs a full scan—slow and costly as data grows.
beats.primary_visual_focus: Sequential scan pointer moving across rows
beats.continuity_from_previous: Table remains in place; scan begins at first row
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: The slow, methodical movement of the pointer emphasizes linear time complexity—each pause represents a disk or memory access.

beats.name: Solution: Index Introduced
beats.teaching_message: An index creates a separate, ordered structure for fast lookups.
beats.primary_visual_focus: B-tree index sliding in above the table, aligned spatially
beats.continuity_from_previous: Table remains; index enters from top
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: Spatial separation reinforces that indexes are auxiliary structures; sorted order contrasts with table's randomness.

beats.name: Fast Index Search
beats.teaching_message: The B-tree allows logarithmic search by eliminating branches at each level.
beats.primary_visual_focus: Tree search narrowing path from root to leaf
beats.continuity_from_previous: Index now static; search animation begins at root
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: Visual elimination of branches shows divide-and-conquer logic—each step halves the search space.

beats.name: Direct Row Access
beats.teaching_message: The index leaf contains a pointer that jumps directly to the target row.
beats.primary_visual_focus: Pointer lookup link from leaf node to target row
beats.continuity_from_previous: Search ends at leaf; pointer emerges
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: The direct line bypasses all other rows, illustrating indirection and physical efficiency.

beats.name: Performance Contrast
beats.teaching_message: Index lookup is exponentially faster than scanning, especially at scale.
beats.continuity_from_previous: Full scene collapses into comparative layout
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: Side-by-side animation shows step count disparity—concrete visualization of algorithmic efficiency.

beats.name: Trade-offs Acknowledged
beats.teaching_message: Faster reads come with costs: storage, write overhead, and maintenance.
beats.primary_visual_focus: Muted inset panel in bottom-right corner
beats.continuity_from_previous: Main visuals dim slightly; inset appears
beats.why_visual_improves_understanding: Prevents oversimplification—acknowledges real-world engineering trade-offs in system design.
